# T-3: Enforce implement completion

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Make implement completion validate requirement status, file-map coverage, and required durable artifacts before the step can be marked done.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Completion fails with a structural envelope when required implementation readiness data is missing.
- Completion succeeds when all observable readiness checks are satisfied.
- The check does not consume reviewRetry or gateRetry.

## Implementation Notes
Start from set-step.js completion validation. Reuse file-map and testability helpers instead of adding parallel parsing logic. Do not require lint readiness until a durable lint artifact or flow-state evidence path exists.

## Test Strategy
Unit tests around set-step completion behavior with minimal active flow fixtures.
